skill.name: css-colors
skill.description: Guides agents to add CSS colors through the Material UI theme instead of direct color codes.
skill.summary: Use theme-based CSS color additions for consistent frontend styling.
skill.author: Crossbill-Highlights

security_audit.summary: Static analysis reported no suspicious patterns across one prompt-only file. Review of SKILL.md found styling guidance for theme-based colors, with no prompt injection, code execution, network access, filesystem access, or credential handling. No remediation is required.

content.user_title: Add CSS Colors Through Theme Rules
content.value_statement: Teams often get inconsistent colors when agents add direct CSS values in component code. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to use Material UI theme colors and customColors.
actual_capabilities: Directs agents to prefer existing Material UI palette colors.
Discourages direct color codes inside component code.
Explains where new custom colors should be added.
Supports consistent CSS color decisions during frontend edits.
Keeps color guidance concise for agent-assisted code changes.
limitations: Does not define the actual palette values.
Does not validate CSS or theme files automatically.
Does not generate accessibility contrast reports.
Depends on the project having a Material UI theme structure.

use_cases.title: Maintain Theme Consistency
use_cases.description: Apply new UI colors without adding one-off color values in component styles.

use_cases.title: Review Agent Styling Changes
use_cases.description: Check that AI-generated CSS follows the project theme and customColors convention.

use_cases.title: Document Color Rules
use_cases.description: Give contributors simple guidance for where project colors should live.

prompt_templates.title: Choose an Existing Color
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner task for a small style update.
prompt_templates.prompt: Update this component color using the existing Material UI theme palette. Avoid direct color codes in component code.

prompt_templates.title: Add a Themed Custom Color
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate task when no current palette color fits.
prompt_templates.prompt: Add a new reusable color through the theme customColors section, then update the component to reference that theme color.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor Direct Colors
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of existing component styling.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find direct color values in this component and replace them with suitable theme palette or customColors references.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Color System Change
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced task across related UI surfaces.
prompt_templates.prompt: Propose a theme-based color update for these UI states. Prefer existing palette values and add customColors only when necessary.

output_examples.input: A component needs a new highlight color for selected text.
output_examples.output: Use an existing theme palette color if it matches the design. Add a customColors entry only when the palette has no suitable option.

output_examples.input: A style change includes a direct hexadecimal color value.
output_examples.output: Replace the direct value with a theme reference. This keeps component styling aligned with the shared design system.

output_examples.input: A contributor asks where to put a new brand accent color.
output_examples.output: Place the reusable color in the theme customColors section, then reference it from components that need the accent.

best_practices: Check the existing Material UI palette before adding new colors.
Add reusable project-specific colors to customColors.
Keep component styles tied to theme references.
anti_patterns: Adding direct color codes inside component code.
Creating duplicate custom colors for the same visual role.
Bypassing the theme when a palette color already fits.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It guides agents to add CSS colors through the project theme instead of direct component values.

faq.question: Does it create new color values automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance for where new reusable colors should be added.

faq.question: Which design system does it reference?
faq.answer: It references a Material UI theme and its palette or customColors section.

faq.question: Can Claude Code use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks the skill as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it check accessibility contrast?
faq.answer: No. Users should run separate contrast checks when choosing final color values.

faq.question: Is executable code included?
faq.answer: No. The skill is prompt-only guidance and contains no scripts or executable files.
